[SWS_DM_01030] Observability of the UDS DTC status byte
⌈
If an AA
calls the function ara::diag::DTCInformation::GetCurrentStatus( dtc), the
DM shall provide the current status of the given dtc ID from within the corresponding
ara::diag::DTCInformation instance.
